meanings.tr: eksik ücret almak, olması gerekenden az para talep etmek
meanings.en: to charge someone less than the correct amount
meanings.exampleEn: The waiter undercharged us, so we paid only half the bill.
meanings.exampleTr: Garson bizden eksik ücret aldı, bu yüzden hesabın sadece yarısını ödedik.

meanings.en: a layer of paint applied before the final coat
meanings.exampleEn: Apply an undercoat before painting the wall with the final colour.
meanings.exampleTr: Duvarı son renkle boyamadan önce bir astar sürün.

meanings.tr: ast, emir kulu, alt kademe çalışan (küçümseyici)
meanings.en: a person of lower rank or status, especially one regarded with contempt
meanings.exampleEn: The manager left the boring tasks to his underlings.
meanings.exampleTr: Müdür sıkıcı işleri astlarına bıraktı.

meanings.en: lowest in position
meanings.exampleEn: The undermost layer of the cake was soaked in syrup.
meanings.exampleTr: Pastanın en alt katı şuruba batırılmıştı.

meanings.en: not having enough food for good health and growth
meanings.exampleEn: Many children in the region are undernourished and underweight.
meanings.exampleTr: Bölgedeki birçok çocuk yetersiz beslenmiş ve zayıf durumda.

meanings.tr: atlet, iç fanila, gömlek altına giyilen iç giysi
meanings.en: a piece of underwear worn under a shirt
meanings.exampleEn: He wore a white undershirt beneath his dress shirt.
meanings.exampleTr: Gömleğinin altına beyaz bir atlet giymişti.

meanings.tr: hayal kırıklığına uğratmak, beklenen etkiyi yaratamamak
meanings.en: to fail to impress or excite someone
meanings.exampleEn: The much-hyped film underwhelmed most critics.
meanings.exampleTr: Çok reklamı yapılan film çoğu eleştirmeni hayal kırıklığına uğrattı.

meanings.en: not deserving something, especially help or reward
meanings.exampleEn: He felt undeserving of such generous praise.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu kadar cömert övgüyü hak etmediğini hissetti.

meanings.en: not developed; without buildings, industry, or advanced systems
meanings.exampleEn: The land remained undeveloped for decades.
meanings.exampleTr: Arazi onlarca yıl boyunca gelişmemiş halde kaldı.

meanings.en: accepted by everyone; not questioned or doubted
meanings.exampleEn: She is the undisputed champion of the sport.
meanings.exampleTr: O, bu sporun tartışmasız şampiyonudur.

meanings.tr: gün ışığına çıkarmak, ortaya çıkarmak, kazıp çıkarmak
meanings.en: to find something in the ground by digging, or to discover hidden information
meanings.exampleEn: Archaeologists unearthed ancient coins at the site.
meanings.exampleTr: Arkeologlar bölgede antik paralar buldular.

meanings.en: to discover something previously hidden or secret
meanings.exampleEn: Reporters unearthed evidence of corruption.
meanings.exampleTr: Muhabirler yolsuzluk kanıtları ortaya çıkardı.

meanings.en: dug up from the ground or newly discovered
meanings.exampleEn: The recently unearthed documents revealed the truth.
meanings.exampleTr: Yakın zamanda ortaya çıkarılan belgeler gerçeği açığa vurdu.

meanings.en: not producing a profit; not making good use of money or resources
meanings.exampleEn: The mine was closed because it had become uneconomic to run.
meanings.exampleTr: Maden, işletmesi ekonomik olmaktan çıktığı için kapatıldı.

meanings.en: not having the right to something
meanings.exampleEn: Part-time workers were unentitled to the bonus.
meanings.exampleTr: Yarı zamanlı çalışanlar ikramiyeye hak sahibi değildi.

meanings.en: not special or unusual; ordinary
meanings.exampleEn: The meal was pleasant but unexceptional.
meanings.exampleTr: Yemek hoştu ama sıradandı.

meanings.en: not made clear or understood; without a known reason
meanings.exampleEn: The cause of the fire remains unexplained.
meanings.exampleTr: Yangının nedeni hâlâ açıklanamıyor.

meanings.en: the state of not knowing or being used to something
meanings.exampleEn: Her unfamiliarity with the software slowed her down.
meanings.exampleTr: Yazılıma olan yabancılığı onu yavaşlattı.

meanings.en: not worried or surprised by something difficult or unexpected
meanings.exampleEn: She seemed completely unfazed by the criticism.
meanings.exampleTr: Eleştiriden hiç etkilenmemiş görünüyordu.

meanings.en: not able to be done or achieved
meanings.exampleEn: The plan proved unfeasible within the tight budget.
meanings.exampleTr: Plan, dar bütçe içinde uygulanamaz çıktı.

meanings.en: not caring about other people's feelings; cruel
meanings.exampleEn: His unfeeling remarks hurt everyone at the table.
meanings.exampleTr: Duygusuz sözleri masadaki herkesi incitti.

meanings.en: not complete; not brought to an end
meanings.exampleEn: She left the report unfinished on her desk.
meanings.exampleTr: Raporu masasında yarım bıraktı.

meanings.en: not suitable or appropriate for a situation
meanings.exampleEn: His casual clothes seemed unfitting for the formal ceremony.
meanings.exampleTr: Günlük kıyafetleri resmi tören için uygunsuz görünüyordu.

meanings.en: not concentrating or clearly directed
meanings.exampleEn: His argument was unfocused and hard to follow.
meanings.exampleTr: Argümanı dağınıktı ve takip etmesi zordu.

meanings.en: impossible to know about or predict beforehand
meanings.exampleEn: The delay was caused by unforeseeable circumstances.
meanings.exampleTr: Gecikme, öngörülemeyen koşullardan kaynaklandı.

meanings.en: the quality of not showing thanks for something received
meanings.exampleEn: His ungratefulness after all their help was shocking.
meanings.exampleTr: Onca yardımdan sonra gösterdiği nankörlük şaşırtıcıydı.

meanings.en: not injured or harmed
meanings.exampleEn: Amazingly, the driver walked away unhurt from the crash.
meanings.exampleTr: İnanılmaz bir şekilde sürücü kazadan yara almadan kurtuldu.

meanings.en: not clean, and therefore likely to cause disease
meanings.exampleEn: The kitchen was closed for being unhygienic.
meanings.exampleTr: Mutfak hijyenik olmadığı için kapatıldı.

meanings.en: not recognized or named
meanings.exampleEn: An unidentified man was seen leaving the building.
meanings.exampleTr: Kimliği belirsiz bir adamın binadan ayrıldığı görüldü.

meanings.tr: tek dilli, sadece bir dil konuşan
meanings.en: using or able to speak only one language
meanings.exampleEn: The document was published in a unilingual English edition.
meanings.exampleTr: Belge tek dilli İngilizce baskısıyla yayımlandı.

meanings.en: not providing useful information
meanings.exampleEn: The report was long but uninformative.
meanings.exampleTr: Rapor uzundu ama bilgilendirici değildi.

meanings.en: having no people living there
meanings.exampleEn: They landed on a small, uninhabited island.
meanings.exampleTr: Küçük, ıssız bir adaya ayak bastılar.

meanings.en: impossible to understand
meanings.exampleEn: His handwriting was almost unintelligible.
meanings.exampleTr: El yazısı neredeyse anlaşılmazdı.

meanings.en: not planned or meant
meanings.exampleEn: The policy had several unintended consequences.
meanings.exampleTr: Politikanın birkaç istenmeyen sonucu oldu.

meanings.en: continuing without stopping
meanings.exampleEn: We enjoyed eight hours of uninterrupted sleep.
meanings.exampleTr: Sekiz saat kesintisiz uyku çektik.

meanings.en: not having been asked to come
meanings.exampleEn: Several uninvited guests turned up at the party.
meanings.exampleTr: Partiye birkaç davetsiz misafir çıkageldi.

meanings.en: doing or saying something at the same time as others
meanings.exampleEn: The crowd chanted the slogan in unison.
meanings.exampleTr: Kalabalık sloganı tek ağızdan hep bir ağızdan bağırdı.

meanings.en: not neat or tidy; not cared for
meanings.exampleEn: His hair was unkempt and his clothes creased.
meanings.exampleTr: Saçları dağınık, kıyafetleri buruşuktu.

meanings.en: unkind behaviour; the quality of being unkind
meanings.exampleEn: She never forgot his unkindness towards her.
meanings.exampleTr: Ona karşı olan kabalığını hiç unutmadı.

meanings.tr: serbest bırakmak, ortaya salıvermek, açığa çıkarmak
meanings.en: to suddenly release a strong force, feeling, or activity
meanings.exampleEn: The decision unleashed a wave of protests.
meanings.exampleTr: Karar bir protesto dalgasını tetikledi.

meanings.en: except if; used to say something will happen if another thing does not
meanings.exampleEn: We won't get there on time unless we leave now.
meanings.exampleTr: Şimdi çıkmazsak oraya zamanında varamayız.

meanings.en: not having official permission or a licence
meanings.exampleEn: He was fined for driving an unlicensed vehicle.
meanings.exampleTr: Ruhsatsız araç kullandığı için ceza aldı.

meanings.en: the state of being improbable or not likely to happen
meanings.exampleEn: Given the unlikelihood of success, they abandoned the plan.
meanings.exampleTr: Başarı ihtimalinin düşüklüğü göz önüne alınınca planı bıraktılar.

meanings.en: better than any other; without equal
meanings.exampleEn: Her skill as a negotiator is unmatched.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir müzakereci olarak becerisi eşsizdir.

meanings.en: not worth remembering; not special
meanings.exampleEn: The concert was pleasant but ultimately unmemorable.
meanings.exampleTr: Konser hoştu ama sonuçta akılda kalıcı değildi.
